summary: Mozilla directly configures Node auto-instrumentation and imports the trace SDK packages; the grouped update broadens instrumentation dependencies and introduces a future trace-package consolidation path.

findings.title: Exercise Node auto-instrumentation coverage
findings.impact: Both tracing implementations call getNodeAutoInstrumentations, while 0.78 updates the package's broad set of instrumentation dependencies. Existing tracing tests should therefore exercise startup and the instrumented services used by the repository.
recommendedChecks: Run both tracing implementations' startup and span-export tests, including at least one service covered by auto-instrumentation, and compare emitted spans.

findings.title: Current trace imports remain on the legacy package split
findings.impact: The repository imports processors, exporters, and types from sdk-trace-node/base. Version 2.9 introduces sdk-trace as their eventual replacement and documents changed processor constructors only for that new package, so this PR should not proactively rewrite the existing imports.
recommendedChecks: Run TypeScript compilation and the tracing unit tests against 2.9, keeping the existing sdk-trace-node/base imports unless a separate migration adopts the new sdk-trace package.

omittedConcerns: TraceState behavior is omitted because no TraceState usage appears in the supplied repository evidence.
Semantic-convention deprecations are omitted because the repository uses stable ATTR_SERVICE_NAME, not the listed incubating GenAI or Kubernetes exports.
